annotations.title: Compare cost with a local hire

description: Calculates the monthly cost of a local hire from an hourly wage, weekly hours and an optional employer on-cost percentage, and shows it beside the Virtual Assistant Capital plan with the closest hours. Uses only the numbers supplied; treats the wage as US dollars.

employer_cost_percent.description: Optional employer on-costs (payroll taxes, benefits) as a percentage of wages. Defaults to 0.

local_hourly_wage.description: Hourly wage of the local hire, in US dollars.

name: compare_cost_with_local_hire
title: Compare cost with a local hire
